label: Octane
description: Dark with bold electric blue and amber racing accents. Built for automotive performance — car workshops, detailing studios, dealerships, driving schools and auto accessories brands.
notes: Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables. The dark gunmetal bg and electric blue primary give this theme a premium motorsport feel. Amber accent draws attention to CTAs and highlights — like a racing stripe on a dark machine. Space Grotesk headings bring bold, condensed energy while Inter body keeps everything readable. Changing primary here restyles every section, every page, instantly.
